div.div: 5 تَأَيَّمَتْ and تأيّم : see 1, in three places. The former is also explained as signifying She became forlorn (تَحَوَّشَتْ) of her husband. (K in art. حوش.) And also, (TA,) or تَأَيَّمَتْ زَمَانًا, (ISk, T, S,) She remained some time without marrying. (ISk, T, S, TA.) And تأيّم, (Msb, K,) or تأيّم زَمَانًا, (ISk, T, S,) He remained some time without marrying. (ISk, T, S Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
